test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was conferred with a Padma Bhushan Award 2025 in the field of (Posthumous) Affairs in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Sushil Kumar Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padma Bhushan Awards**: The Padma Bhushan is one of India's highest civilian awards, conferred by the Government of India. It recognizes distinguished service of a high order in various fields such as art, literature, sports, public affairs, and others.
 
• **Posthumous Recognition**: The award can be given posthumously to honor the contributions of individuals who have passed away. This demonstrates respect for their legacy and achievements.
 
• **Shri Sushil Kumar Modi** was conferred the award in **April 2025** under the category of **Public Affairs**. His contributions in this field have been highly impactful, making him a deserving recipient.
 
• **Public Affairs Contributions**: Shri Modi has been recognized for his outstanding work in governance and policymaking, which has significantly influenced India’s political and administrative spheres.
 
• **April 2025 Ceremony**: The Padma Awards ceremony is conducted annually, where distinguished individuals are awarded for their remarkable contributions to the nation.
 
• **Other Nominees**: The other options mentioned in the question, such as **Dr. Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy**, **Shri Nandamuri Balakrishna**, and **Shri MT Vasudevan Nair**, have been notable figures in their respective fields, but none of them were conferred the award in 2025 under the category of Public Affairs.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Shri Sushil Kumar Modi.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Padma Awards:**

 
 
• The Padma Awards are divided into three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (for distinguished service of high order), and **Padma Shri** (for distinguished service).
 
• These awards are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day and highlight excellence in various domains such as **arts, science, public affairs, social work, sports, and literature**.
 
 
 
• **Shri Sushil Kumar Modi’s Achievements:**
 
 
• Shri Modi is widely known for his contributions to the field of **governance**, particularly as a senior leader in Indian politics. He has held various important positions, including **Deputy Chief Minister of Bihar**.
 
• He has worked extensively in policy formulation, economic reforms, and public administration, influencing the socio-economic structure of Bihar and India.
 
 
 
• **Other Nominees:**
 
 
• **Dr. Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy:** Renowned for his work in medical sciences and gastroenterology.
 
• **Shri Nandamuri Balakrishna:** A popular actor and politician from Andhra Pradesh, contributing to the entertainment and public spheres.
 
• **Shri MT Vasudevan Nair:** A respected writer and filmmaker from Kerala, known for his contributions to Indian literature and cinema.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Eligibility Criteria:**

 
 
• The Padma Awards are open to all citizens of India, irrespective of age, gender, or profession. Non-resident Indians and foreigners can also be considered for these awards.
 
• Posthumous awards are given in exceptional cases to honor the legacy of an individual.
 
 
 
• **Significance:**
 
 
• The awards serve as a recognition of excellence and inspire others to contribute to the development of society and the nation.
 
• They highlight India’s diverse talent across different domains, fostering a sense of pride and accomplishment.
